title: Alow manipulating `Selector` parts from consumer code
author: phoenix-ru
summary: Adds public `Selector::insert_raw` / `insert_raw_multiple` to the forked selectors crate, inserting components at arbitrary raw indexes without recomputing specificity or flags, for the fervid Vue scoped-style transform.
evidence: No maintainer response in over 3 years. The raw inserts leave the selector's cached specificity/flags (e.g. HAS_PSEUDO) stale, and `insert_raw_multiple` silently ignores an out-of-range index. Master already offers `iter_raw_parse_order_from` plus `impl From<Vec<Component>> for Selector` (rebuilds via SelectorBuilder, recomputing specificity), and `Selector::append`, which may cover the use case without a new unchecked API.
decision: Add an unchecked public API for inserting raw selector components (stale specificity/flags), or close and point consumers to rebuilding via `Selector::from(Vec<Component>)`?
